author: mroguljic
body:
#### PR description:
Backport of #52289 

Follow-up of #52060, which introduced the `SiPixelClusterShapeLimits` payload and `SiPixelClusterShapeLimitsRcd` in 17.0.X (and got included into 17.1.X).

`ClusterShapeHitFilterESProducer` now reads the pixel cluster shape limits from `SiPixelClusterShapeLimitsRcd` in GT instead of the `.par` files. This makes it possible to update the CSF limits through the GT, without a new release. 

The parameters `PixelShapeFile` and `PixelShapeFileL1` are removed; a new optional parameter `pixelShapeLimitsLabel` (default empty) selects the payload label. For HLT, `customizeHLTfor52289` removes the two parameters from the HLT menus. They will need to be removed from the menus in ConfDB.

This backport also removes the customiser for changing the CSF .par files.

No changes in the output are expected: the payloads in the GTs were written from the same `.par` files that are used today.

The PR must be tested together with the autoCond update to the new GTs (https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52327), since the current GTs do not contain the new record.

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Backport of #52289  to 17.1.X
title: [17.1.X] Read ClusterShapeHitFilter pixel limits from GT
